recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus profile portrait of a woman with long blonde hair, framed by a warm, sepia-toned border featuring delicate floral illustrations and elegant script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against a dark, moody background
Delicate floral accents balancing the heavy profile composition
Contrast between structured serif type and fluid script lettering
Framed composition using a textured, parchment-like border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the central and right two-thirds of the frame, looking toward the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face in profile, specifically the eye and bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right script, moves down the subject's hair to the shoulder, then sweeps up the left side through the floral illustration to the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows behind the subject's face provide high-contrast negative space for the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and sepia tones in the border and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and dark brown in the background shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pink and muted green in the floral illustration.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value in highlights; deep, crushed blacks in the shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital hues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic 1970s serif and formal copperplate script.
letterConstructionRules: Title uses high-contrast serifs with ball terminals
Artist name uses a fluid, slanted script with ornate swashes on capitals
Tight letter spacing for the serif block
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the 'M' and 'G' in the script
Overlapping characters in the serif block to create a compact unit
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a delicate, formal script for the artist name.

preserve: The stacked layout of the serif text
The ornate swashes of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s serif aesthetic with ball terminals.
Provides the necessary calligraphic script elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s style profile portrait of a blonde woman looking left, set against a dark background. Frame the image with a warm, sepia-toned parchment border. Add a small, hand-painted style pink flower with green leaves in the top-left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in the top right using a dark brown calligraphic script. Add the album title in the top left, stacked vertically, using a high-contrast pink serif font with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and nostalgic?
Is the portrait in a clear side-profile?
Are the two font styles distinct and era-appropriate?

mustAchieve: Warm, glowing highlights on the skin

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background
Check that the floral element looks integrated, not pasted on
Verify the soft-focus effect doesn't obscure the subject's profile features
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus profile + warm sepia border + floral accent + serif/script typographic pairing.
